name: Ui-chan no Niizuma Diary~
original_name: 憂（うい）ちゃんの新妻だいあり～
source:
When they started to date, Yousuke and Ui promised to get married when they ended school. Those days pass in the blink of an eye, and they finally get married.
A young's couple love life, suddenly interrupted when Ui's cousin barges in. 
Still, Yosuke and Ui live a peaceful married life...
